sources.label: Consensys Diligence MetaMask USD audit, administrative controls and trust model
MUSD account freeze and forced-transfer implementation

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The independent mUSD audit identifies privileged roles that can freeze and seize assets, including a Freeze Manager and Forced Transfer Manager. MUSD source implements role-gated forced transfers from frozen accounts. The canonical Ethereum proxy still resolves to implementation 0x37a309611e1d278cddc341e479957ec8bc6256ce at block 26095802; this review replaces the inferred centralized-governance rationale with sourced token-level capability evidence.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: MetaMask USD has one canonical native issuance route on Ethereum, where M0 M is created by the immutable MinterGateway and MUSD wraps hub-native M through the Ethereum SwapFacility. Linea and Monad MUSD are bridge representations: M0 Portal v2 burns and mints spoke M, then the local SwapFacility wraps it. Their token and SwapFacility proxy-admin paths, Portal roles and UUPS upgrades, Hyperlane adapter peers, mailbox default ISM validation trees, pauses, and the absence of a token-specific Portal rate limit are assessed here as Bridge Risk and are excluded from Mint Authority posture. October 1 pinned reads supersede the historical two-validator default ISMs with aggregation and routing trees; their Ethereum-origin multisig branches use six of nine validators.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex mint/bridge boundary migration; Pharos V9 Phase 3 curation lane cur-4

routes.protocol: M0 extension minted by wrapping hub-native $M
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain at Ethereum block 25575129: the mUSD proxy reads name 'MetaMask USD', 6 decimals, and mToken() 0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b. That hub $M has a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot, no portal(), and minterGateway() 0xf7f9638cb444d65e5a40bf5ff98ebe4ff319f04e, so it is minted natively on Ethereum rather than bridged in. The mUSD contract holds 12,301,332.20 $M against 12,301,156.85 mUSD outstanding, confirming one-for-one hub wrapping with no inbound bridge leg.

routes.protocol: M0 Portal v2 burn-mint $M through Hyperlane, wrapped into the local MUSD extension
routes.reviewNote: At Linea block 32198405 on 2026-10-01, mUSD mToken(), spoke M portal(), the hub-domain default adapter and adapter mailbox retain their recorded addresses. The adapter uses the mailbox default ISM, now 0xd9c340f695f4970db784a66e05e48df3c49fc4e2. Its Ethereum-origin routing tree includes six-of-nine validator multisigs, superseding the historical two-validator ISM. Local M remains the M0 Portal burn-mint representation and mUSD wraps that spoke M; complete validation-tree semantics and key custody remain unresolved.

controls.label: Linea MUSD representation token upgrade timelock

routeChecks.signingModel: The 3-of-5 Safe 0x5916ec446793e8740645e57a63dc7bc5910c7724 holds proposer, executor, and canceller roles on the Linea MUSD upgrade timelock.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The timelock minimum delay is 259,200 seconds; no token-specific Portal rate limit is implied by this representation upgrade control.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Linea MUSD proxy used implementation 0x58a3a9c561591bab0dd11110eca755ea455f1841 and ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9 at the reviewed representation observation; the ProxyAdmin owner path is the three-day MUSD timelock.

controls.evidence: At Linea block 31369840, the MUSD representation proxy used the recorded implementation and common ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9; its owner path was the 259,200-second timelock with the shared 3-of-5 Safe. This representation upgrade authority is retained here and is not counted as native Ethereum MUSD mint authority.

controls.label: Linea M0 SwapFacility representation route

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Linea SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against spoke M; it does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Representation extension minting is bounded by available spoke-M-backed wrapper flow and the M0 Portal burn/mint accounting path.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable local MUSD cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Linea SwapFacility is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with ProxyAdmin 0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924; its owner is Linea TimelockController 0xa7bdf17af97d06d674d03086e90a18c2d90732b6 with a three-day delay.

controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against spoke M; it can mint representation balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: At Linea block 31369840, the SwapFacility representation route used implementation 0x9e0fdb26954bc8998158c0c921c8254bd6dfe5ec and ProxyAdmin 0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924. Its three-day timelock owner path can replace the wrapper logic, but the resulting capability remains bridge-representation issuance against spoke M rather than a new native MUSD liability source.

controls.label: Linea Hyperlane mailbox default ISM validator set

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Linea block 32198405, adapter interchainSecurityModule() is zero, selecting mailbox 0x02d16bc51af6bfd153d67ca61754cf912e82c4d9 default ISM 0xd9c340f695f4970db784a66e05e48df3c49fc4e2. This aggregation requires both a module-type-6 branch and routing ISM 0x729a93c47ef1115960cf0af49b5e696437eaea03.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: For Ethereum origin domain 1, routing selects aggregation 0x08929d30e9396f234892a499f4de4d6101cef123, requiring one of two multisig branches. Both decoded branches require six of nine validators. The outer module-type-6 branch reports paused() = false; its complete validation semantics and validator key custody remain unverified.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The external validator quorum is the reviewed route approval control; no token-specific Portal rate limit was evidenced.

controls.evidence: Historical default ISM 0x29c3d1759e2995550aa84d102ca928ec9e505db8 had two validators. At Linea block 32198405 on 2026-10-01, mailbox defaultIsm() instead returns 0xd9c340f695f4970db784a66e05e48df3c49fc4e2, and adapter interchainSecurityModule() is zero. modulesAndThreshold() decodes a two-of-two outer aggregation with module-type-6 0x0cedb173a71139d0ff5ec08eadaf3eb5d6932aaf and routing module 0x729a93c47ef1115960cf0af49b5e696437eaea03. The Ethereum-origin route selects one-of-two aggregation 0x08929d30e9396f234892a499f4de4d6101cef123 over merkle-root and message-ID multisigs 0x280ff4f9a3be8042f1b2fd080c29c74bffa0f92f and 0xd4ee1b93afcf916da21b7977c3bde6bf21ccd285. Each validatorsAndThreshold() read returns nine validators and threshold six. Old validator keys remain historical evidence, not the current validation tree.
